verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public API reference, an official MCP server and an official CLI (datadog-ci), so operations across many items can presumably be scripted or agent-driven. However, no evidence describes native bulk endpoints or bulk-edit features, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints or bulk-edit UI actions, MCP tools that operate on many items at once, hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
